name: ailbert
description: Self-discovering Dilbert-style comic strip: writer proposes gag+panel JSON, renderer materializes a sketchy SVG strip, verify_strip.js scores and feeds back.

scripts.test: node --input-type=module -e 'import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process"; import { copyFileSync, readFileSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs"; import { createHash } from "node:crypto"; mkdirSync("work", { recursive: true }); const h = (f) => createHash("sha256").update(readFileSync(f)).digest("hex"); const run = (f, arg) => { const r = spawnSync("node", [f, "--panel", arg], { encoding: "utf8" }); if (r.status !== 0) { console.error(r.stdout); console.error(r.stderr); process.exit(1); } }; for (const g of ["golden-1", "golden-2"]) { const p = "fixtures/" + g + "/panel.json"; run("src/renderer/render-strip.js", p); copyFileSync("out/strip.png", "work/" + g + "-a.png"); const a = h("work/" + g + "-a.png"); run("src/renderer/render-strip.js", p); const b = h("out/strip.png"); const committed = h("fixtures/" + g + "/strip.png"); if (a !== b) { console.error(g + ": NON-DETERMINISTIC render"); process.exit(1); } if (a !== committed) { console.error(g + ": committed PNG does not match current renderer output"); process.exit(1); } run("scripts/verify_strip.js", p); console.log(g + ": deterministic, committed match, verify PASS"); } console.log("npm test OK");'
scripts.lint: node --check src/schema/validate.js && node --check src/schema/manifest-loader.js && node --check src/renderer/rough-bubble.js && node --check src/renderer/compose.js && node --check src/renderer/font.js && node --check src/renderer/render-strip.js && node --check scripts/verify_strip.js && node --check scripts/build-site.js
